text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"varied sentence openings and transitions like \"However,\" \"Overall,\" and \"I remember that one time,\"","quality":"organizational control","description":"This captures more deliberate paragraphing and smoother movement between ideas than the other essay."},{"evidence":"extended personal examples about family vacation, friends, and getting lost in Vietnam","quality":"development","description":"This captures fuller elaboration of ideas with specific supporting details rather than repeated general statements."},{"evidence":"\"translate English to Vietnamese\" and \"communicate with others Vietnamese\"","quality":"idea expression","description":"This captures clearer communication of intended meaning even when grammar is imperfect."},{"evidence":"direct dialogue and quoted speech like \"Xin Chao\" and \"Help me, I lost, I can't find my parent\"","quality":"illustrative detail","description":"This captures the use of concrete examples and dialogue to make the writing more vivid and comprehensible."},{"evidence":"generally understandable phrasing across the essay despite errors","quality":"sentence clarity","description":"This captures stronger overall readability and more consistent sentence-level meaning."}]}
